revenue.source: Revenues from sales, consolidated statement of income: FY2022 from 4Q22 results release (8 Feb 2023); FY2023 and FY2024 from 4Q24/FY2024 results release (5 Feb 2025). USD millions.

operating_income.source: not found - TotalEnergies does not report an IFRS operating income line and I could not retrieve the full-year income statements (search limit reached). Reviewer to fill from the URD.

d_and_a.source: Depreciation, depletion, amortization and impairment, FY2024 13,107 and FY2023 13,818, TotalEnergies Q4 2024 accounts PDF (cash-flow statement). FY2022 not found.

capex.source: not found for full years. Only 9M figures retrieved: additions to intangible assets and PP&E 9M2024 11,229 and 9M2023 12,646 (6-K, Q3 2024 accounts). Reviewer to fill.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2024 revenue fell 10.7% (218,945 to 195,610) on lower oil/gas prices; assume a further mild decline in 2025 on softer prices, then flat and low growth in line with price normalisation and LNG/electricity volume growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption, not derived from filed EBIT (not found). Rough placeholder for an integrated major at mid-cycle prices; reviewer to check against FY2024 URD.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: TotalEnergies' effective tax rate is high because of upstream production taxes in high-tax jurisdictions. Not verified against filings.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2024 D&A 13,107 / revenue 195,610 = 6.7% (Q4 2024 accounts PDF and results release).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: 9M2024 capex of 11,229 against 9M2024 revenues of about 148,495 is about 7.6%. Rounded up to 8% for the 2025 investment plan. Full-year capex not found.

wacc.source: Assumption: integrated oil and gas major, beta around 0.9, risk-free rate about 3%, ERP about 5.5%, modest leverage (gearing 8.3% at FY2024), USD cash flows.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run inflation to reflect long-term energy transition risk to hydrocarbons.

net_debt.source: FY2024 year-end from the 4Q24 release net debt table: current borrowings 7,929 + other current financial liabilities 664 + non-current financial debt 35,711 (excludes leases) - cash 25,844 - current financial assets 6,536 = 11,924. The company's reported net debt is 10,930; it also nets non-current financial assets of 1,027 and held-for-sale items of 33.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares for 2024, 2,315 million, from the 4Q24 results release (adjusted diluted EPS $7.77). Millions of shares.
